fields.title: CPBN bid record
fields.description: One record per bid/notice. Shape depends on recordType: BID_OPEN / BID_UNDEREVALUATION / BID_CANCELLED / BID_AWARDED / BID_CLARIFICATIONS / BID_OPENINGREGISTER / BID_NOTICES / BID_ALL (whichever listType mode=list produces) or BID_DETAIL (mode=detail, a raw label/value passthrough of the bid's own detail page -- field set varies per bid/procurement type, so extra fields beyond those listed below may appear). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a page/bid fails or is inaccessible.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:<listType>'. For detail records: the bidId or URL that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-<listType>-listing, S1-detail, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found_or_restricted).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: BID_OPEN, BID_UNDEREVALUATION, BID_CANCELLED, BID_AWARDED, BID_CLARIFICATIONS, BID_OPENINGREGISTER, BID_NOTICES, BID_ALL, or BID_DETAIL.

_totalAvailable.title: Total available
_totalAvailable.description: Total rows CPBN's listing page returned for this listType (all rows come back in one response), before any maxResults truncation. mode=list only.

bidId.title: Bid ID
bidId.description: CPBN's internal numeric bid id, when this bid has its own detail page. null for older PDF-only notices that predate the interactive bid-tracking system (see 'title'/'date' instead).

bidUrl.title: Bid URL
bidUrl.description: Link to the bid's full detail page on CPBN, when it has one (null for PDF-only notices).

title.title: Bid title
title.description: The bid/notice's title, usually including its own procurement reference number.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: The procuring entity's own procurement reference number, when shown separately from the title (bids with a detail page).

closingDateAndTime.title: Closing date and time
closingDateAndTime.description: Bid submission deadline, CPBN's own free-text date format (e.g. '5th August, 2026 11:00').

date.title: Date
date.description: For older PDF-only notices with no separate detail page -- the single date CPBN shows for that notice (meaning varies: issue date, cancellation date, clarification date, etc. depending on listType).

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: PDF documents attached to this bid, as {label, downloadUrl}. Some downloadUrls are direct public PDF links (/uploads/files/...); others go through a CPBN 'request access' form (/ajax/download/...) that asks for name/phone/email/company before releasing the file -- this actor does not fill in that form or fetch the file, only records the link CPBN itself shows.

pageTitle.title: Page title
pageTitle.description: BID_DETAIL only -- the <title> of the bid's detail page.

category.title: Category
category.description: BID_DETAIL only -- e.g. Works, Goods, Services.

institution.title: Institution
institution.description: BID_DETAIL only -- the public entity running this procurement.

bidDocumentPrice.title: Bid document price
bidDocumentPrice.description: BID_DETAIL only -- fee and payment instructions for obtaining the full bidding document.

openingOfBids.title: Opening of bids
openingOfBids.description: BID_DETAIL only -- where/when bids are publicly opened.

bidClarifications.title: Bid clarifications
bidClarifications.description: BID_DETAIL only -- how/when to request clarifications.

nonCompulsoryPreBidMeetingSiteVisit.title: Pre-bid meeting / site visit
nonCompulsoryPreBidMeetingSiteVisit.description: BID_DETAIL only -- present only for bids that have one.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
